reference_mechanic: Move vertices of a fixed straight-line graph until no two non-incident edges cross; the graph has no prescribed target layout.
transformation: A new self-contained seeded generator uses cycle, wheel, and double-ring planar graph families. It permutes the canonical vertex positions to create a tangled visible start, while the grader independently replays the submitted mouse transcript and checks vertex separation, fixed edge identity, crossings, and overlaps.
